comment: Models the settings app can download into %LOCALAPPDATA%\LLaIME\models. Installed as <root>\models\catalog.json. An entry with an empty repo is not published yet and is shown as unavailable. Files are fetched from https://huggingface.co/<repo>/resolve/main/<name> and checked against size and sha256. Other GGUF models are added in the settings app by pasting a Hugging Face link.

models.name: Qwen3.5-2B 台灣 LoRA（建議）
models.description: 以台灣正體中文語料微調的 2B 語言模型，選字最準（評測 dev 88.6%）。建議 4 GB 以上顯示記憶體；CPU 也能跑但較慢。

models.name: Laya 中文排序器（CPU 模式）
models.description: 沒有顯示卡時用的編碼器排序器，純 CPU 每次約 50 ms。
